title: formsculpt

catalog.name: FormSculpt
catalog.summary: 3D sculpting and modeling, with a Rust engine and a command set agents can drive.

notes_for_owner: Renamed from formsculptor: the old desktop.yml called ./formsculptor, this entry uses ./formsculpt. Not in formportal's products.json (under either name): the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json (project file .fsc from the file association). formsculpt.bat has no install-desktop or desktop command, so Windows runs ./formsculpt from Git Bash (windows_shell bash), exactly as the old workflow did. plugins.updater.pubkey is empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made.
